requirement: No PAN/CVV/PIN/OTP/raw payment credential is collected or stored
Hosted checkout or provider-controlled secure component is the default
Payment data fields are classified and minimized
No card data or provider secret appears in logs/traces/analytics
PCI scope is assessed with acquirer/provider and qualified assessor
Price and plan are resolved from server catalogue
Money uses integer minor units and explicit ISO currency
Order snapshots immutable plan and price versions
Server recomputes tax/discount/total eligibility
Client amount/currency/status/entitlement fields are ignored
Checkout requires authenticated owner and valid order
Checkout attempt binds provider merchant environment and order
Checkout creation is idempotent by principal operation and request hash
Provider network calls occur outside DB transaction
Provider URLs are origin-allowlisted and TLS validated
Return URLs cannot be open redirects
Redirect or client callback never proves payment
Webhook ingress is isolated per provider/account/environment
Webhook signature uses exact raw request bytes
Webhook signature comparison follows provider-safe verification
Webhook timestamp and replay window are enforced
Webhook key IDs and controlled rotation are supported
Webhook validates merchant account and environment
Webhook validates transaction/order/amount/currency correlation
Webhook body size/content type/encoding are bounded
Durable inbox receipt exists before acknowledgment
Provider event identity is unique and deduplicated
Duplicate and out-of-order events cannot regress state
Unknown outcomes remain pending pending reconciliation
Authenticated provider status lookup resolves ambiguous events
Order/payment/refund/subscription/entitlement states are separate
Entitlement owner consumes verified payment facts only
Payment module cannot directly mutate learner entitlement records
Financial evidence is append-only with compensating corrections
Refund amount cannot exceed captured balance less completed refunds
Refund request approval and provider execution are separate
High-risk refunds require independent approval per approved policy
Refund completion requires verified provider evidence
Disputes and chargebacks have independent lifecycle and audit
Subscription renewal requires verified period and amount evidence
Cancellation and mandate behavior require legal/product approval
Reconciliation compares internal and provider records
Reconciliation variance never silently mutates financial state
Manual adjustment is separately authorized and audited
D13 outbox/inbox delivery is idempotent and at-least-once safe
Payment API routes have risk-based quotas and abuse controls
Refund/order reads enforce owner and field-level scope
Support cannot set success or self-approve privileged refund
AI cannot charge refund or alter paid entitlement
Provider secrets are stored only in managed secret boundary
Provider keys and webhook secrets are environment-separated
Secret rotation and emergency revocation are auditable
Provider egress uses fixed allowlist and SSRF-safe handling
Audit captures privileged payment and financial transitions
Telemetry excludes credentials and unnecessary payment metadata
Retention/legal hold for financial evidence is legally reviewed
Payment incidents have containment and reconciliation playbooks
Provider outage preserves pending state and bounded retries
Settlement reconciliation and accounting ownership are defined
Live payments require E14 evidence and E15 explicit approval
